    Comparing K(Q₀) with the derived category of Rep k I #

    The functor G : K(Q₀) ⥤ D(Rep k I) is ι₀ on complexes followed by the localization. It is bijective on morphisms into the resolution complexes (their images are K-injective), and G(resC l) ≅ l in the derived category through the quasi-isomorphism qmap l. Lifting the inclusion of the interval category into D(Rep k I) along G gives the functor resFunctor which sends an interval to its resolution (Step 1 of the proof of Proposition 2.3).
